calendar.text: Minutes of the Fed’s October meeting
Final euro area inflation for October (first estimate: 4.0%)
Trump, Xi and Putin are due to meet in Shenzhen
Spain: TV debate between Sánchez and Feijóo
COP31 is due to end in Antalya
EU summit: leaders aim to choose the next ECB president
The new US Congress takes office

corrections.t: 18 Nov 2026, Kerch Bridge story: an earlier version said Russian attacks killed two people in Kyiv. Kyiv officials reported one person injured there.

held.t: Iran: a Euronews report that the US struck missile launchers in southern Iran on Sunday night. No second source and no US confirmation in the reports seen.

Ukraine: a Russian official’s statement, carried by state media, that 1,200 to 1,300 prisoners from each side could be exchanged. No independent confirmation, and no sign yet that the exchange has started.
Ukraine: a report that European leaders agreed a joint negotiating team on 13 November. One source so far.
ECB: reports that policymakers expect to raise rates in December and then pause. One source so far.
China: reports that October industrial output and retail sales missed forecasts. One source so far.
Iran: a Reuters report that the crew of a tanker is missing in the Strait of Hormuz. One source so far.
Iran: a Bloomberg report that Iran threatened to hit civilian sites near US or Israeli bases if its own civilian sites are attacked. One source so far.

Israel: a Channel 12 report, carried by other outlets, that aides to Prime Minister Netanyahu gave police tips that led to arrests of Arab party workers on election day. Not yet independently confirmed.
Nvidia: an NPR report that Jensen Huang says he would be honoured to return and has agreed to testify to Congress. One source so far.
Bahrain: an Anadolu report that Bahrain’s air defences stopped several Iranian attacks early on Wednesday. One source so far.

note: Overnight check. Updates: Nvidia’s board says it will not bring Huang back, and shares rose after the results; Iran confirmed the US strike on Qeshm Island. Correction to the Kerch Bridge story about casualties in Kyiv.
